title: Adaptive embedding compatibility shim and granular tenant phased activation
creator: Riley Chen
description: Add a lightweight compatibility shim plus tenant-aware calibration to safely onboard new embedding models (and quantized variants) into the existing embeddings + reranking stack. Goal: allow immediate traffic routing to a new model variant without requiring full vector reindexing or a large offline migration. The shim will provide projection and normalization transforms (per-tenant when necessary) and serve as a compatibility layer for similarity semantics across model families and quantization levels.
acceptance_criteria: Can enable new embedding model for a single tenant via feature flag (0% -> 100%) with no offline reindex required
Reranking endpoint p95 latency increase <= 15ms at 10% tenant activation; capacity plan documented
Semantic quality regression (recall@10 on canonical eval set) <= 1.5% vs baseline for the first 10 tenants; automated smoke tests pass
Automatic rollback triggers implemented: cosine-shift > 0.12 on tenant eval set OR error-rate spike > 3x baseline
Telemetry dashboards show per-tenant transform stats, L2 norm distributions, and alignment scores within 48 hours of activation
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal shadow routing (no production traffic) and offline projection validation for 3 days. Phase 1: Canary tenants (selected low-risk tenants) at 1% traffic for 48 hours with active QA. Phase 2: Gradual tenant activation by cohort buckets (5, 10, 25, 50, 100% of traffic) with 24-72 hour hold windows and automated checks. Phase 3: Full activation and begin deprecation timeline for old model variant after stable metrics for 7 days. Feature flags + per-tenant config through Console; fallback routing to baseline model on trigger. No global reindex required; migrate index gradually if/when customers opt in.
telemetry_signals: per-tenant L2 norm distribution of embeddings
cosine similarity shift between new model and baseline on tenant probes
reranker p95/p99 latency and CPU/GPU utilization during activation
query-level topK overlap (Jaccard) and recall@K on validation prompts
error rates and fallback occurrences per tenant
cache hit/miss rate for prefix/KV caches when using projected embeddings
implementation_notes: Compatibility shim implemented as a small inference microservice that performs: per-model linear projection, optional per-tenant affine normalization, and L2 clipping when necessary
Expose lightweight proto for transform metadata so Console and telemetry can surface transform versions
Integrate with routing layer to allow weighted routing to projected embeddings for reranking endpoint
Provide a local validation harness (python) to run canonical prompts and compute alignment metrics before enabling feature flag
GPU work is limited to model inference for the new embedding; projection runs on CPU/GPU depending on latency sensitivity
Add config knobs: projection matrix version, norm clipping threshold, tenant-specific bias vector path
risks_mitigations: Risk: semantic drift causes silent quality regressions. Mitigation: require smoke evals + hold windows and automatic rollback based on alignment thresholds
Risk: added transform latency increases reranker SLA violations. Mitigation: measure p95 in shadow runs, enable CPU fallback or async projection caching for high-traffic tenants
Risk: projection fails for extreme quantized vectors. Mitigation: add per-model preprocessing and degrade to baseline model when transform error rate crosses threshold
Risk: operational complexity for tenant-level configs. Mitigation: standardize defaults and expose a 'safe' preset in Console for most customers

2025-03-06: Telemetry schema (metric names + tags) agreed with Observability; dashboard prototype link added. Decided to scope tenant-specific bias vectors to opt-in only.
2025-03-10: Started integration with routing layer (feature-flag toggle implemented). Running 48h internal shadow for two pilot tenants. Priya N. assigned to lead rollout QA.
